scripts.dev: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only hosting,auth,firestore
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:emulators
scripts.test:emulators: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project bad-game-pickleball "node --test tests/app-integration.test.js tests/firebase-rules.test.js tests/migration.test.js tests/event-integration.test.js"
scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm test && npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
